name: SA Veneri-12
about: SA Veneri-12 (1978-086C, IKI/BABTS), launched 1978 Sep 14. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Venus. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Venus on GCAT's date); GCAT gives no heliocentric orbit to check it against (solved: perihelion 0.707 au, aphelion 1.060 au)
